variant.description: Effort / harness / fallback settings the score was produced under.

asOf.description: Research cut-off for everything in this file.

watchlist.description: Announced or rumoured models we are tracking but cannot onboard yet.

modelIds.description: Catalog model ids the run is about (otherwise matched from the routes).

processor.description: Who processes prompts/outputs on this route, e.g. "AWS (Bedrock)" or "Anthropic (independent processor)".

taiwanResidency.description: Whether any option keeps processing inside Taiwan.

enterpriseNotes.description: Taiwan-enterprise specific notes: residency, zh-TW quality, regulation.

merges.description: Exact `action` texts of EARLIER digest action items that this item updates; the Radar folds them into this item.

topic.description: Same task across days, merged into one Radar action item (same format as DigestItem.topic).

unverified.description: Facts the research job could not verify from a primary source.

check.description: true = coverage note ("checked, no change"): the Radar shows it under a separate collapsed block, not as news.

merges.description: Exact titles of EARLIER digest entries of the same section that this entry updates; the Radar folds them into this entry.

topic.description: Same subject across days, merged into one Radar card (within the same section). Format "<area>:<subject>[:<aspect>]", lowercase, e.g. "pricing:claude-sonnet-5-5", "litellm:recommended-version", "cve:cve-2026-89032", "lifecycle:gemini-api:gemini-3-1-flash-image".

geography.description: Human description of where data is processed, e.g. "Japan (ap-northeast-1/3)".

id.description: The id you put in `model`, e.g. "jp.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5".

conflicts.description: Other published dates for the same event.  - "conflicting": another current official page shows this date. Plan to the earliest    (builders keep `date` = the earliest current date).  - "superseded": an older announcement replaced by the current source. Show as history only    (a reminder that dates move, sometimes earlier) — never count down to it.

scopeNote.description: Regions / deployment types the event applies to.

LifecycleStatus.description: CSP-side lifecycle state of a model on one channel.

knownPitfalls.description: Cross-model parameter pitfalls seen through the gateway.

minVersionBundledCostMap.description: Oldest image with the model in the bundled cost map (LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=true).

minVersionParams.description: Oldest version with correct parameter handling for this model family.

minVersionRouting.description: Oldest version that can route the model when the remote cost map is reloaded.

supported.description: Inside LiteLLM's "four most recent stable lines" window at `asOf`.

id.description: Canonical slug, stable across CSPs, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5".

platformStatus.description: Decision on YOUR platform. Seeded as "evaluating" for new models.

releaseDate.description: First public release by the vendor (any channel).

summary.description: One-paragraph zh-TW summary for list views.

vendorModelId.description: Vendor first-party model id (Anthropic API / OpenAI API / Gemini API).

Offering.description: One route: a model on one cloud service.

apacAvailability.description: Regions most relevant to a Taiwan-based enterprise (TW / JP / KR / SG / AU / IN).

aliases.description: Stable aliases on your gateway -> concrete targets.

enterpriseNotes.description: What a platform team should know before saying yes: licence, origin, safety, serving cost.

heatReason.description: One sentence: why this heat level, quoting the signals.

origin.description: Where the developer is headquartered, as commonly reported (matters for procurement rules).

priceNotes.description: Price points that help compare (CSP list price, vendor API, cost per benchmark task). Free text with units.

releaseDate.description: First public release or announcement of this version.

status.description: released = weights downloadable now; preview = API or early access only, weights promised; announced = neither yet.

OpenModelHeat.description: Market traction, judged by the rules published in OpenModelsFile.method. hit = already heavily used; rising = new and gaining; watch = tracked for another reason.

OpenModelHosting.description: One row per CSP service we track. "not-offered" rows are kept on purpose: absence is information.

modelId.description: Model or inference-profile id on that service, when offered.

value.description: Short human-readable value, e.g. "週用量第 2（28.4T tokens，+36%）".

available.description: true when the weights can be downloaded today.

customLicense.description: true when the licence is a vendor-specific text that legal must read before any use.

license.description: SPDX-style id when standard ("apache-2.0", "mit"), otherwise the vendor's licence name.

repos.description: Hugging Face repo ids (or another download location).

marketNotes.description: Short market read for this period.

method.description: How heat is judged and what each signal means; shown on the page.

metrics.description: All latency values are milliseconds; throughput is tokens/second.

modelId.description: Catalog model id the run is about (otherwise matched from the route: "<modelId>" or "<modelId>@...").

route.description: Gateway alias that was called, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5@bedrock-jp".

PerformanceReference.description: External speed/latency reference (e.g. Artificial Analysis). Your own runs go in PerfRun.

ttftSec.description: Seconds to first token as defined by the source (reasoning models: often includes thinking).

PlatformStatus.description: Internal platform decision for a model (your gateway), not the CSP state.

cacheWrite.description: Cache write at the default TTL (5 min for Anthropic, 30 min for OpenAI on Bedrock).

firstSeen.description: Digest id (date) where the entry first appeared.

id.description: Stable id: a hash of the normalised text (curation merges can point several texts at one id).

seenIn.description: Every digest that carried it (oldest first).

state.description: "due" = has a due date not yet passed; "open" = no due date, still within the carry window.

topic.description: The subject key the item was merged by (DigestActionItem.topic or radar/curation.json `topics`).

updates.description: Earlier statements folded into this item, newest first, excluding the current one.

RadarActionUpdate.description: An earlier wording of a merged Radar action item (newest first; the item's current wording is not repeated).

RadarCheck.description: A coverage note ("checked, no change"): DigestItem.check, or an entry listed in radar/curation.json `checks`.

id.description: The entry's own id (hash of its section and normalised title), for radar/curation.json.

RadarCuration.description: Human / agent decisions the roll-up applies (radar/curation.json — outside data/, which a release replaces).

checks.description: Legacy news entries that are coverage notes ("checked, no change"), as if they carried `check: true`.

close.description: Action items done or no longer relevant before their due date. Applies to the item that contains `id` while no other entry merged into it restated the subject after `id`'s last statement.

merge.description: Several texts that say the same thing: the entries listed in `ids` become one entry with the id `keep` (newest wording wins).

rewrite.description: New wording for an action item (e.g. a merged tracker without the models that launched). Ignored once a newer digest restates the item.

topics.description: Topics for entries written before digests carried `topic`: every entry id listed (news "it-…" or action "ai-…"; an entry's own id or a card id) gets the topic, so entries of the same subject become one card.

asOf.description: The version of this view = the newest digest id.

checks.description: Coverage notes ("checked, no change") of the last 3 digests, newest first; per section only the notes of the newest digest that has any. Never part of the news sections. Shown collapsed.

coverage.description: Earliest periodStart and newest periodEnd of the digests merged.

retired.description: Action items that dropped out in the last 14 days (expired due date, closed or stale) — shown collapsed.

rules.description: The merge rules in force (shown on the page).

RadarTopic.description: Subject key of a digest entry: the same subject reported on different days carries the same topic and is merged into ONE Release Radar card (latest wording + dated history). Format "<area>:<subject>[:<aspect>]", lowercase, e.g. "pricing:claude-sonnet-5-5", "litellm:recommended-version", "cve:cve-2026-89032", "lifecycle:gemini-api:gemini-3-1-flash-image".

RadarUpdate.description: An earlier statement folded into a merged Radar news card (newest first; the card's current wording is not repeated).

alwaysOn.description: True when thinking cannot be switched off (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5).

metricDefinitions.description: Standard definitions the portal should display next to performance numbers.

behaviours.description: Behaviours that change what the API returns (refusal routing, watermarking, etc.).

classifications.description: Vendor risk classification, e.g. "OpenAI Preparedness: Cyber = Critical".

programmes.description: Trusted-access programmes relevant to security / life-science teams.

SecurityCase.description: One case of a security run as published: the text fields are empty for every case of a sensitive dataset.

risk.description: risk of the dataset (tools/secsuite/manifest.json); anything but none / low is never shown as text

target.description: target label (the column of the summary), "gateway" for SEC-16

SecurityItemResult.description: One target's result for one security test item (tools/secsuite: aggregate counts only, never prompt or response text).

rate.description: fail / scored (attack success rate or failure rate, per the item's KPI).

SecurityRunCases.description: runs/security/<runId>.cases.json: `sec_suite.py publish` - only the full portal shows it; the clean build leaves it out.

public.description: always true: the cases were redacted for a page many people can open

SecurityRunSummary.description: runs/security/<runId>.json: what `sec_suite.py run --publish-summary` writes (G6 AI 安全測試).

items.description: tier A = blocks the model's release when it fails (tools/secsuite/catalog.json).

methodology.description: what the item tests, how a case is scored, and the pass rule (from the catalog, for the page)

simulated.description: true when the built-in simulator answered instead of a model.

targets.description: label: the column name in results; modelId: the catalog model it stands for (else matched from label / model).

note.description: Optional pointer inside the source, e.g. a table name or section.

TestPurpose.description: Why a test was run. "pre-release" = evidence for a release gate before a model (or a gateway change) goes live; the model page's 內部測試 tab shows those first. Older run files have no purpose (shown as 未標示).

Verification.description: How much to trust a fact. `derived` = computed by us from other official facts.
